# /crav1-complete-tasks

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: reference only · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-complete-tasks/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Orchestrate isolated [`/crav1-complete-task`](crav1-complete-task.md) workers for a T# range or all unchecked tasks.

## Runs when

Several tasks on one spec. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The `T#` queue on one spec.

Reads the `T#` queue on one spec.

## Writes

In short: The commit-style rule once, when missing; one worker per `T#` writes that task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits.

Writes the commit-style rule once when it is missing.

## Does not

Leaves product code, commits, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-branch`](crav1-feature-branch.md) and `crav1-complete-task-agent` once per `T#`.

## Lane and group

Lane: Build. Group: Build. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).
